people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”
translations.bsb: “Woman, what is that to you and to Me?” Jesus replied. “My hour has not yet come.”
translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
